findings.title: Past cancelled reminders are deleted without being cancelled in SendGrid
findings.body: The deleteMany at lines 34-41 runs BEFORE the new cancellation block at lines 44-77. It deletes ALL email reminders with scheduledDate <= now, including ones marked cancelled:true that have not yet been cancelled in SendGrid. The subsequent findMany at lines 44-51 cannot find them because they were already deleted, so the SendGrid cancellation is never sent. If a booking is cancelled while its reminder's scheduled time has already passed (e.g., when the CRON has been unavailable for an extended period), the email is still sent by SendGrid. The cancellation lookup is also written to include past reminders (lte: now+1h), so the design clearly intended them to be cancelled here. Fix: add `cancelled: { not: true }` to the deleteMany where clause, or reorder the steps so cancellation runs first.

findings.title: Workflow deletion races with SendGrid cancellation
findings.body: At lines 212-218, scheduledReminders.forEach calls deleteScheduledEmailReminder(reminder.id, reminder.referenceId, true) without awaiting. These calls perform async SendGrid POST /v3/user/scheduled_sends cancellations. The next statement, `await ctx.prisma.workflow.deleteMany` at line 220, runs immediately and cascades through WorkflowStep.onDelete: Cascade to delete the workflowReminder rows. The SendGrid cancellation request may not have been sent, let alone processed by SendGrid, before SendGrid's scheduled send time, so the cancelled email is still delivered. Fix: await the cancellation calls (e.g., `await Promise.all(scheduledReminders.map(async (r) => { ... }))`) before issuing the workflow delete.

findings.title: Workflow step deletion races with SendGrid cancellation
findings.body: Same race as the workflow-deletion finding. At lines 519-525, remindersFromStep.forEach fires SendGrid cancellations via deleteScheduledEmailReminder(reminder.id, reminder.referenceId, true) without awaiting, then `await ctx.prisma.workflowStep.delete` at line 527 cascades to delete the workflowReminder rows before the SendGrid cancellation requests may complete. Cancelled-step reminders can still be sent.

findings.title: No tests for the new CRON cancellation flow
findings.body: The PR introduces a new WorkflowReminder.cancelled field, a new branch in scheduleEmailReminders.ts that finds and cancels cancelled reminders in SendGrid, and significant new logic in deleteScheduledEmailReminder (new signature with reminderId and immediateDelete option, plus the soft-cancel path that only sets cancelled:true). None of these have automated test coverage. The original bug (#7225) was specifically about cancelled reminders still being sent; without tests, regressions in this code path would re-introduce the same user-visible problem and would not be caught.
